placements.why: Dario's rule that every shelf carries a fill line at a third is a stated rule for a recurring pantry operation. It sits with the restock-threshold positions already under this narrative, so reuse fits and no new leaf is needed.

weighed.why: Its below-a-third restock rule is the threshold the fill line makes visible, so it supports the operating-rhythms leaf alongside the new position.
Its per-shelf thresholds, including the oats and rice exception, are the rules the shelf marks make checkable. It belongs under the same leaf.

mints.name: PantryRestockingPractice
mints.title: How the pantry decides when to restock a shelf: the fill thresholds and the marks that make them checkable
mints.why: Several positions about pantry restocking (the one-third rule, the oats and rice exception, the fill-line marking) are about one subject. The existing strata offer no grouping for it.

connections.why: It concerns how the restock threshold is made visible on the shelf.
It sets the per-shelf fill levels that the marks must reflect.
It carries the below-a-third restock rule that opens this practice.

unconnected.why: It is reused and covers intake and pantry operations broadly. The pantry stratum minted here holds only the pantry positions, not the narrative as a whole.
